home.title: FoxNetwork — Maintenance for distributed networks
home.description: Parcel lockers, ATMs, EV chargers: one maintenance partner across every site in Île-de-France. Fixed price per intervention, SLA held, photo proof on close.

quote.title: Get a quote
quote.description: Tell us about your estate — we come back within 48 hours with a costed proposal.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: How FoxNetwork collects, uses and protects your personal data.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.description: The terms governing use of FoxNetwork services.

legalNotice.title: Legal notice
legalNotice.description: Publisher and hosting information for the FoxNetwork website.

hero.subtitle: Report what's broken in seconds, track every request in one place, and call in an intervention the moment you need one.

networks.subtitle: One maintenance partner across every site. We dispatch, fix and close the ticket — your network stays available.

lockers.name: Locker networks
lockers.description: Parcel lockers, click-and-collect points, return hubs. Doors, screens, payment terminals, power.

atms.name: ATM networks
atms.description: Cash dispensers, deposit machines, kiosks. Uptime, cash-jam clearing, hardware swaps.

ev.name: EV charging stations
ev.description: AC and DC chargers, fast-charging stalls, payment readers. Faults, cables, connectivity.

coverage.body: Pick any asset in the region and we are on it. Full coverage across all eight départements, with the same SLAs everywhere.
coverage.mapLabel: FoxNetwork coverage across Paris and Île-de-France

pricing.subtitle: One price to get us on site, first hour included*. Pick the SLA that matches the urgency — we hit it, or we carry the cost.
pricing.footnote: *Covers the first hour on site — additional time billed hourly. Travel not included, billed at roughly €1/km. Prices excl. VAT. Volume contracts available: talk to us about your fleet.

booking.subtitle: Bookings happen inside your client dashboard. Every intervention is logged, priced and tracked end to end.

report.title: Tell us what's broken
report.description: Pick the asset, describe the issue, attach a photo. Two minutes from your dashboard.

choose.title: Pick an SLA tier
choose.description: Relaxed, Standard, Urgent or Critical. You see the price before you confirm.

close.title: We dispatch and close
close.description: A technician is assigned, you track them live, and the ticket closes with photo proof.

dashboard.title: Live network dashboard
dashboard.description: Every site, every intervention, every cost in one view. Filter by network, asset type or SLA. Export at month-end.

transparency.title: Transparent by default
transparency.description: Photo proof on every close. Time-stamped status. Fixed prices before you confirm. Invoiced from the dashboard.

cta.title: Your network, kept up.
cta.body: Spin up a client workspace, add your first asset, and book an intervention in under five minutes.

footer.tagline: Maintenance for distributed networks, orchestrated end to end — from the report to the invoice.
